verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server docs describe programmatically downloading expense report data for analysis or for loading into an accounting package, using generated API credentials. That is a first-party export path, but it covers report data only and names no file formats. Accounting syncs to QuickBooks or NetSuite move data into other vendors' systems rather than giving a self-service open-format export, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented full-account export of all data (receipts, cards, travel, invoices), explicit open formats such as CSV or JSON, an account-closure or offboarding flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
